processes.command:
bash -lc 
printf '%s\n' "${BASHPID}" > '/tmp/uav_usv_lab.DeRixS/px4.pid' &&
source '/home/qin/Projects/PX4-Autopilot/build/px4_sitl_default/rootfs/gz_env.sh' &&
export GZ_SIM_SERVER_CONFIG_PATH='/tmp/uav_usv_lab.DeRixS/magnetometer_enu.config' &&
export PX4_GZ_MAGNETOMETER_ENU=1 &&
export PX4_GZ_GNSS_NO_DELAY=1 &&
export GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH='/tmp/uav_usv_lab.DeRixS/models':'/home/qin/data/uav_usv_mpc/src/uav_usv_bringup/models':${GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH:-} &&
export PX4_GZ_MODELS='/tmp/uav_usv_lab.DeRixS/models' &&
export PX4_GZ_STANDALONE=1 &&
export PX4_GZ_WORLD=default &&
# Face Gazebo +Y (local NED north), where the USV starts 8 m away.
export PX4_GZ_MODEL_POSE='0,0,0,0,0,1.57079632679' &&
cd '/home/qin/Projects/PX4-Autopilot' &&
make px4_sitl gz_x500_mono_cam;
component_status=$?;
if [[ ! -f '/tmp/uav_usv_lab.DeRixS/restarting' ]]; then exec bash; fi;
exit ${component_status}

/usr/bin/python3 /opt/ros/humble/bin/ros2 launch uav_usv_bringup p765_perception_probe.launch.py enable_evaluator:=true enable_shadow_perception:=false front_depth_model:=ideal enable_down_camera:=false config_file:=/home/qin/data/uav_usv_mpc/src/uav_usv_bringup/config/p76_yan_paper.yaml
